question: What animals that were mentioned in both Ilias Lagkouvardos's and Olga Tapia's papers on the alvei species of the genus named for Copenhagen outside the bibliographies were also present in the 2021 article cited on the alvei species' Wikipedia page about a multicenter, randomized, double-blind study?

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Task intake: Identify the genus named for Copenhagen (likely Hafnia), confirm the 2021 multicenter randomized double-blind article cited on the species' Wikipedia page, then extract animals mentioned in both Lagkouvardos's and Tapia's papers on Hafnia alvei (excluding bibliographies) and see which of those animals are present in the 2021 article. Plan: 1) Verify Hafnia/Hafnia alvei Wikipedia and the 2021 Nutrients article. 2) Locate relevant papers by Ilias Lagkouvardos and Olga Tapia specifically about Hafnia alvei. 3) Extract animal mentions from their main texts. 4) Cross-check overlap with animals present in the 2021 article. Team: WebSurfer for web pages, Assistant for comparison and synthesis, FileSurfer for notes.
